evals.prompt: 把仓库文档做成中英双语，参考项目的多语言约定。
evals.expected_output: Applies the migration: core model first (canonical/translated pairs, manifest), phase-gated workflow with one independent commit per phase, translation rules, validation gates.
assertions: Builds the manifest/state model before moving files
Phases the migration with per-phase gates

evals.prompt: 文档已搬到 docs/en/ 但状态没更新，怎么管理？
evals.expected_output: Uses the canonical state machine and blob integrity rules: manifest state is the source of truth, not the directory; drift rolls back to In Review.
assertions: Treats manifest state as source of truth

evals.prompt: 翻译成英文时哪些标识符必须保留？
evals.expected_output: Applies the translation rules: preserve code identifiers, enums, requirement IDs, must/should strength; only translate prose.

evals.prompt: 迁移 PR 已经 squash 合并了，本地 main 怎么同步？
evals.expected_output: Follows the post-migration remote merge procedure: verifies origin's version contains the fix before reset, never merges a stale superseded local commit.
assertions: Verifies origin main is strictly newer
Uses reset, not merge, for superseded commits
